releases.name: v1.2.0: setup hard gate + guided wizard · i18n · 11-locale READMEs
releases.body:
# v1.2.0

## What's new

### Setup hard gate + guided wizard (`/switchman-setup` / `/switchman-setup-chat`)
Unconfigured task pools no longer fall back to "all models": **task dispatch is hard-blocked until every one of the six task pools has at least one selected model and the capability ranking has at least one entry**. A new guided wizard covers the whole matrix in one pass — `/switchman-setup` (TUI: resumable intro jumping to the first unfinished step, one multi-select dialog per pool in lane order with immediate per-pool persist, then a strongest-first ranking pick over the selected union, then a done screen naming any providers that still need a restart) or `/switchman-setup-chat` (the same flow in chat for non-TUI clients). While incomplete, main sessions carry a `[SETUP]` directive and every task denial relays the remedy; the gate opens the moment the last config file is saved (mtime hot-reload, no restart — a restart only registers brand-new providers). Shells/internal sessions are exempt; sidebar notice + `[LIMITS]` banner segment report the missing state.

### Render-time i18n (11 locales)
Sidebar chrome, pool/rank/handover dialogs, status-log notices, and config-CLI copy now localize at render time (`src/i18n.ts`; locale chain: project language → global `ui.lang` → terminal env → English). Six-lane sidebar labels localize display-only; model-facing protocol copy stays byte-stable English.

### Changed
- **Real-fail isolation window 30 min → 5 min** — probe-ok-but-real-call-failed states auto-unlock after 5 minutes (they are usually transient vendor blips); rate-limit keeps its 10-min self-heal TTL, endpoint errors keep 6h, restart clears everything.
- **Model rank scoped to the task-pool universe** — `/modelRank` ranks exactly the pool-selected universe; non-pool entries auto-prune on write; the manual rank is now the absolute ordering key on pool lanes; pool members are exempt from capability-level floors.
- **Economy lane effort preference medium→high→low→minimal** — a medium-less flash model now takes its high face as the economy chain head instead of being pinned to low.
- **Self-read budget defragmented** — tolerance band (~400 tok over R* passes outright), per-call headroom-sized grants (max 2× R*), and bounded continuations merging into one completion shot.

### Docs
- `/switchman-setup` & `/switchman-setup-chat` documented in both READMEs (quick start restructured: wizard = step 3 required-once) and as a full required step in both quick-start guides, plus the reference manuals.
- README translated into 9 more locales — 繁體中文 · 日本語 · 한국어 · Español · Français · Deutsch · Italiano · Português · Русский — 11 languages total under a unified language switcher.

## Test plan
- `bun test`: 551 pass / 0 fail
- `bun run typecheck`: clean

---

# v1.2.0 更新说明(自 v1.1.1 以来)

## 新增

### 配置硬门槛 + 引导向导(`/switchman-setup` / `/switchman-setup-chat`)
未配置的任务池不再回落「全部模型参与」:**六个任务池每池至少一个模型、能力排名至少一条,配置完成前任务派发被硬性拦截**。新增引导式向导一次跑通整个矩阵——`/switchman-setup`(TUI:可续跑首页直达首个未完成步骤,按车道序逐池多选、每池确认即刻落盘,再在入选并集上按能力强到弱点选排名,完成页点名仍需重启的 provider)或 `/switchman-setup-chat`(非 TUI 客户端在对话里走同样流程)。未完成期间主会话每轮携带 `[SETUP]` 指令、每次任务拒绝都附带补救指引;最后一个配置文件保存的瞬间门槛即开(mtime 热加载,无需重启——重启只为注册全新 provider)。壳/内部会话豁免;侧栏通知与 `[LIMITS]` 横幅段报告缺失状态。

### 渲染时国际化(11 种语言)
侧栏界面、任务池/排名/交接弹窗、状态日志通知与配置 CLI 文案改为渲染时本地化(`src/i18n.ts`;语言链:项目语言 → 全局 `ui.lang` → 终端环境 → 英文)。六车道侧栏标签仅显示层本地化;面向模型的协议文案保持字节级英文稳定。

## 变更
- **真实失败隔离窗口 30 分钟 → 5 分钟**——探针通过但实际派发失败的状态 5 分钟自动解锁(多为供应商瞬时抖动);限流保留 10 分钟自愈 TTL,端点类错误保留 6 小时,重启即全部清空。
- **模型排名限定任务池宇宙**——`/modelRank` 只对池内选中宇宙排名;池外条目写入时自动修剪;手动排名成为池车道上的绝对排序键;池内成员豁免能力等级下限。
- **economy 车道努力度偏好调整为 medium→high→low→minimal**——不支持 medium 的 flash 模型改以其 high 面作为 economy 链首,不再被钉死在 low。
- **自读预算碎片整理**——容忍带(R* 超出约 400 tok 直接放行)、按剩余余量定-sized的单次授予(最高 2× R*)、有界续读合并为一次完成读。

## 文档
- `/switchman-setup` 与 `/switchman-setup-chat` 写入中英 README(快速上手重构:向导 = 第 3 步必做)、中英快速上手指南完整必做步骤,以及中英参考手册。
- README 新增 9 种语言译本——繁體中文 · 日本語 · 한국어 · Español · Français · Deutsch · Italiano · Português · Русский——共

releases.name: v1.1.1: broad-search clarify gate
releases.body:
## What's new

### Broad-search clarify gate
Before a main session runs its first whole-project search, the plugin now stops it once and asks you for more precise file guidance.

- Detected shapes: unscoped recursive glob (`**/*.ts`), pathless `grep` (include filters don't scope location), and recursive `rg` / `grep -r` / `find .` / `fd` anchored at the project root
- The denied call carries a verbatim marker question (`switchman-search-scope`): with narrower paths the search is redone scoped to them; without guidance (or on a decline) the exact call is retried and passes once the ask completed
- Per-session latch — one ask per session; anti-deadlock fail-open after repeated denies without an ask; shell subagent sessions exempt (a delegated scouter is the sanctioned broad-search path)
- Conservative bash detection: only the first pipeline segment is analyzed, value-flag operands (`--glob`, `-g`, `-e`, `--include`, `-name`, …) are skipped, exclusion globs (`'!node_modules'`) are never mistaken for path operands
- Protocol clause added to agents-md section 5; toggle via jsonc `"search": { "clarify": false }` (default on)

## Test plan
- `bun test`: 502 pass / 0 fail
- `bun run typecheck`: clean

releases.name: v1.1.0: shell soft tiers · [ROUTE] line · ro bash allowlist
releases.body:
# v1.1.0 — graceful shell lifecycle, routing discipline, and a friendlier gate

## English

### Added
- **Shell subagent soft tiers + inline HANDOFF relay** — two graceful advisories (conserve → hand-off) now precede the hard-cap termination, reusing the main session's absolute thresholds (soft 50k / hard 90k by default). A spent shell ends with `HANDOFF: inline · progress: n/m · next: …`; protocol §2 codifies it as the authoritative remaining-work state. Window-clamped pull-down keeps tiers under the real termination line; `context.subagentForceTokens` is now optional and defaults to `forceTokens`.
- **Per-turn `[ROUTE]` line** — the token cost model (hands-on grows this session's context; a dispatch spends a fresh shell context) plus the declaration discipline, on every main-session turn from a single pure module.
- **`dispatch: "off"` project opt-out** — stand down all task-call governance via `.switchman/settings.json` (read per call, no restart); caps/lang/watermark gates deliberately stay on.
- **Locale-following language ask** — first-run questions localize into 11 locales from env `LC_ALL`/`LANG`; the capture anchor stays byte-stable so parsing is locale-independent.
- **Injection mode `configured`** — narrows the injected shell face to the configured models' shells (fail-open to `chain` when nothing is configured).

### Changed
- **Read-only shells gain a read-only bash allowlist** — `git status/diff/log/show/blame/…`, listing-only forms of mutable git commands, and search/inspect utilities (`rg`, `grep`, `ls`, `cat`, `head`, `tail`, …) now run on ro shells; `edit` stays denied and `find/sed/awk/echo` stay blocked (mutation forms).
- **Default context watermarks retuned 60/80/120k → 50/90/130k** — earlier conserve signal, more wrap-up room, longer handover runway; subagent advisories and the shared 130k termination line follow automatically. Explicit user `context.*` values are untouched.
- **ROUTE_META gate: synthesize-and-observe instead of deny** — a missing/malformed META gets a lane-default synthesis + status note and the dispatch proceeds; a present-but-wrong META still denies with the sample. The three plugin-side prompt-rewrite retries collapse into the gate; redirected dispatches carry the prompt as-is.

### Upgrade notes
Restart opencode to apply (startup-level injection changes). Users relying on the missing-META deny as a discipline prod should note the `[ROUTE]` declaration discipline is now the replacement surface.

## 中文

### 新增
- **子代理软阈值 + 内联 HANDOFF 交接** — 硬终止前新增两级优雅建议（收缩 → 交接），直接复用主会话绝对阈值（默认 soft 50k / hard 90k）。耗尽的 shell 以 `HANDOFF: inline · progress: n/m · next: …` 结尾；协议 §2 将该交接块定为剩余工作的权威状态。窗口钳位等比下拉，建议线永不越过真实终止线；`context.subagentForceTokens` 改为可选，缺省跟随 `forceTokens`。
- **每回合 `[ROUTE]` 行** — 携带 token 成本模型（亲自操作逐回合增长本会话上下文；派发只消耗全新 shell 上下文）与"每个实质动作前声明"纪律，由单一纯模块渲染。
- **`dispatch: "off"` 项目级退出** — 在 `.switchman/settings.json` 设置即让全部 task 治理下岗（每次调用重读，无需重启）；上限/语言/水位门禁保留。
- **语言询问跟随 UI locale** — 首次询问按环境变量 `LC_ALL`/`LANG` 本地化为 11 种语言；捕获锚点字节稳定，解析与 locale 无关。
- **注入模式 `configured`** — 注入面收窄为已配置模型的 shell（未配置时回退 `chain`）。

### 变更
- **只读 shell 获得只读 bash 白名单** — `git status/diff/log/show/blame/…`、易变 git 命令的列表形态、以及搜索/查看工具（`rg`、`grep`、`ls`、`cat`、`head`、`tail` 等）现在可在 ro 壳执行；`edit` 仍拒绝，`find/sed/awk/echo` 因存在变异形态继续禁止。
- **默认上下文水位 60/80/120k → 50/90/130k** — 收缩信号更早、收尾空间更大、交接跑道更长；子代理建议与共享 130k 终止线自动跟随。用户显式配置的 `context.*` 不受影响。
- **ROUTE_META 门禁从拒绝改为合成观察** — 缺失/不可解析的 META 合成 lane 默认值并放行（附状态注记）；存在但错误的 META 仍附样例拒绝。插件侧三处改写重试收敛进门禁本身，重定向派发原样携带 prompt。

### 升级提示
重启 opencode 生效（注入面为启动级变更）。若你曾依赖"缺 META 即拒绝"作为纪律鞭策，请注意 `[ROUTE]` 行的声明纪律是替代面。

releases.name: v1.0.4: /ctx-pause //ctx-resume
releases.body:
## New (EN)
- `/ctx-pause` / `/ctx-resume`: suspend/resume THIS session's context watermark control (read gates, self-read budget, auto-handover) at any time.
- Plugin-side capture (event layer + chat-messages transform layer; no model cooperation needed), session-scoped, idempotent.
- While paused, the [WATERMARK:SESSION] line keeps reporting measured numbers with a PAUSED notice; a >=95%-of-window pure-text warning stays live (overflow hard-errors the session regardless of pause).
- Fail-safe direction: an opencode restart auto-resumes control.

## 新增 (中文)
- `/ctx-pause` / `/ctx-resume` 命令：随时挂起/恢复当前会话的上下文水位控制（读门、自读预算、自动交接）。
- 捕获由插件完成（事件层 + 消息 transform 层，不依赖模型配合）；仅作用于当前会话；幂等。
- 暂停期间 [WATERMARK:SESSION] 行继续报数并附 PAUSED 标记；保留 >=95% 窗口纯文字告警（无论是否暂停，窗口溢出都会硬错误）。
- 安全方向：重启 opencode 自动恢复控制。

releases.name: v1.0.3 — /modelRank interleaved ranking, runaway-scroll fix, full-superset config lists
releases.body:
## Added

- **`/modelRank` interleaved ranking — manual entries merge into the base-score ordering** — the manual ranking no longer floats as a block on top of everything. The dialog (and `rank list`) now show one merged ordering sorted by effective capability, and a move (ctrl/alt+up/down or the per-model actions) acts on that merged list: the moved model gets an anchored manual score strictly between its new neighbors (tier from the neighbor below, raw at the midpoint of the same-tier gap, or a ±0.001 decimal step at tier boundaries and tie groups), so nudging a model one spot no longer requires manually ranking every model above it — unranked models materialize an anchored entry on their first move. Anchored scores persist in `capability-rank.json` as an optional `scores` side-map (`{ key: { tier, raw } }`); entries without a stored score keep the legacy ladder semantics (linear percentile by array position), so hand-written and pre-existing files stay valid, and CLI `rank set/add/remove` preserve surviving anchored scores. Dispatch surfaces are unchanged in shape — a manual hit still overrides the base capability score, now via the anchored (tier, raw) pair.
- **Full-superset candidate lists for `/modelRank` & `/poolConfig`** — both config surfaces now list every conversable model of credentialed providers (the full superset) instead of the pruned injection face, so task pools can be configured with models that are not favorites/visible yet, and models already configured in a pool stay listed even when they drop out of the pruned face (force-keep). Actual chain candidacy is still decided at runtime by pool selection ∩ activation.

## Fixed

- **Runaway list scrolling in the `/modelRank` dialog** — moving the mouse up/down across the list could set off a wild, never-ending scroll: the plugin mirrored every hover-driven selection change back into the dialog's `current` prop, and the host dialog re-centered the scroll on `current` each time — the centering scroll slid fresh rows under the stationary cursor, each firing another hover → selection change → re-scroll: an unbounded self-sustaining loop. `current` is now driven only by explicit ctrl/alt+up/down hotkey moves, never mirrored from hover.

---

## 中文说明

### 新增

- **`/modelRank` 交错排名——手动条目并入基础分排序** —— 手动排名不再整块浮顶。弹窗（及 `rank list`）现在展示按有效能力合并排序的单一列表，移动操作（ctrl/alt+up/down 或回车菜单）作用于该合并列表：被移动的模型会获得一个严格介于新上下邻居之间的锚定手动分（档位取下邻居的档，同档取分数中点，跨档位/同分用 ±0.001 小数步进拉开），上移一格不再需要把上面的模型全部手动排一遍——未排过的模型首次移动即落锚。锚定分以可选 `scores` 边表（`{ key: { tier, raw } }`）存入 `capability-rank.json`；未存分的条目保持旧阶梯语义（按数组位置的线性百分位），手编/旧文件完全兼容，CLI `rank set/add/remove` 会保留未涉及条目的锚定分。调度面形状不变——手动命中依旧覆盖基础能力分，只是分数来自锚定的 (tier, raw)。
- **`/modelRank` 与 `/poolConfig` 候选列表扩为全量超集** —— 两个配置面现在列出有凭据 provider 的全部可对话模型（全量超集），而不仅是裁剪后的注入面；任务池可以配置尚未收藏/可见的模型，池内已配置的模型即使掉出裁剪面也强制保留在列表中（force-keep）。实际链路候选仍由运行时「池选择 ∩ 激活面」决定。

### 修复

- **`/modelRank` 弹窗疯狂滚动** —— 鼠标在列表上上下划过可能触发停不下来的极速滚动：插件把每次悬停产生的选中变化回写进弹窗的 `current` 属性，宿主弹窗每次都对 `current` 执行居中滚动——居中滚动把新行滑到静止的光标下方，又触发新一轮悬停 → 选中变化 → 再滚动，形成无界自持循环。现在 `current` 仅由 ctrl/alt+up/down 快捷键移动驱动，不再镜像悬停。

**Full changelog**: https://github.com/mrzturn/opencode-switchman/compare/v1.0.2...v1.0.3
